request: When someone buys more than 10 of anything they should get 10% off, and it should show on the page. Also the checkout total feels slow.

items.phrase: When someone buys more than 10 of anything they should get 10% off
items.requirement: When one cart line has 11 or more units of a product, take 10% off that line (rounded down to whole cents). Add tests test_bulk_discount_over_ten and test_no_discount_at_ten.
assumptions: 'more than 10' means 11 or more; exactly 10 units pay full price
the discount applies per product line, not to the whole cart
amounts stay in whole cents, rounding the discount down

acceptance.description: 12 mugs cost 10% less than full price, exactly 10 mugs cost full price, and the existing tests still pass.

items.phrase: it should show on the page
items.requirement: The shop page shows '10% off' next to the total when the discount applies.
assumptions: the label appears after the customer clicks Calculate

acceptance.description: Maya enters 12 mugs, clicks Calculate and sees '10% off' in the total.

items.requirement: Make computing totals faster without changing any result; the price API must stay fast under light load.
assumptions: 'slow' means computing totals, measured by bench.py
5 simultaneous users is a reasonable light load

acceptance.description: Totals are measurably faster, and with 5 users 95% of price requests answer within 200 ms.

checks.question: Does computing a cart total avoid re-reading the catalog file for every cart line?

open_questions: Should the discount also apply when 11+ units are spread over different products (e.g. 6 mugs + 5 caps)? This plan assumes no.

personas.name: Maya, buys mugs in bulk for her cafe
personas.description: Opens the shop page, asks for 12 mugs and expects to see the bulk discount.

personas.name: A checkout widget calling the price API
personas.description: Asks the price API for 12 mugs.

optimizer.goal: Make computing a cart total faster (the user said checkout feels slow)

data_notice: Nothing leaves this machine: the scripted test model is used (no AI provider is called).
